extracted.intended_audience: Department of the Interior officials, Indian agents, Congressional auditors, and administrators responsible for Indian trust lands and funds
extracted.subtask_description: Procedures and official requirements for establishing, modifying, cancelling, restoring, and administratively recording Indian reservations and for accounting/appropriating interest and proceeds related to tribal trust bonds and land sales. Covers metes-and-bounds boundary descriptions, withdrawal/restoration language, and trust accounting entries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Withdrawal and setting apart land for Indian use
rubrics_metrics.description: It is hereby ordered ... be, and the same is hereby, withdrawn from sale and settlement and set apart for the use and occupancy of said [tribe].
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Executive orders establishing reservations must include explicit language withdrawing land from sale and settlement and declaring it set apart for the use and occupancy of the named tribe or band. The order typically names the reservation by description and specifies that the land is for the tribe's use and occupancy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cancellation of prior reservation orders
rubrics_metrics.description: It is hereby ordered that so much of the order of December 27, 1875, as relates to the Aqua Calienta Indian Reservation in California be, and the same is hereby, canceled.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Executive orders may explicitly cancel or modify portions of prior orders; the cancellation should identify the prior order/date and specify the extent (e.g., particular sections, townships) of cancellation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Restoration of reservation lands to public domain
rubrics_metrics.description: be, and the same hereby is, restored to the public domain.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Where lands are released from reservation status they must be declared 'restored to the public domain' in the order. The order should describe the tract and boundaries being restored and indicate the legal effect (restoration to public domain).

rubrics_metrics.name: Addition to existing reservation
rubrics_metrics.description: be, and the same is hereby, withdrawn from sale and settlement and set apart for the use of the ... as an addition to the present Navajo Reservation in said Territories.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Executive orders adding land to an existing reservation must state that the described lands are withdrawn and set apart as an addition to the named reservation. The instrument should reference the existing reservation and state the intended administrative effect.

rubrics_metrics.name: Metes-and-bounds boundary description requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: All that portion of sections numbered 25, 26, and 27, township 11 south, range 3 east, lying north of the following line, viz: beginning on the north boundary line of section 25 ... thence south 74° west, 34.60 chains ... to the place of beginning.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Orders must provide precise boundary descriptions using legal subdivision identifiers (sections, townships, ranges), bearings, distances (chains), physical markers (stones, trees), meridians, parallels, and clear 'place of beginning' closure language so the tract can be unambiguously identified and mapped.

rubrics_metrics.name: Secretary to notify General Land Office
rubrics_metrics.description: The Secretary of the Interior will cause the same to be noted in the General Land Office.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: After issuing an executive order affecting public land status, the Secretary (or responsible official) must ensure the change is recorded/noted in the General Land Office (GLO) or equivalent land records office for administrative effect and public record.

rubrics_metrics.name: Interest collected carried to credit of trust-fund
rubrics_metrics.description: Total interest collected during the time specified and carried to the credit of trust-fund interest due various Indian tribes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Interest receipts on United States bonds held in trust for tribes are to be totaled for specified periods and credited to the tribes' trust-fund interest accounts. The statement enumerates interest sources (U.S. bonds, paying State stocks, collected paying bonds) and shows aggregation to a total carried to credit.

rubrics_metrics.name: Congressional appropriations for non-paying stocks
rubrics_metrics.description: Statement of appropriations made by Congress for the year ending June 30, 1880, on non-paying stocks held in trust by the Secretary of the Interior for various Indian tribes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When posted to accounts, appropriations for non-paying stocks must be reported by bondholder/state (e.g., Arkansas, Florida, North Carolina), showing principal amount and the annual interest appropriated. The accounting statement should list principal and annual interest apportioned for each entry and provide a total.

rubrics_metrics.name: Collections of interest falling due within specified periods
rubrics_metrics.description: Collections of interest made since November 1, 1879, falling due since July 1, 1879; entries list fund or tribe, period (from–to), kind of bonds, and amounts collected.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Interest collections are recorded against specific funds/tribes with explicit 'from' and 'to' dates and the bond type/face amount. Records must show the period for which interest is collected and map each payment to the relevant fund/tribe and kind of security.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accounting for receipts and disbursements from sales of Indian lands
rubrics_metrics.description: The receipts and disbursements since November 1, 1879, on account of sales of Indian lands ... are exhibited in the following statement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proceeds from land sales must be reported in a statement that ties amounts to specific appropriations, acts, or treaty provisions, and details the use or destination of funds (e.g., fulfilling specific treaties, proceeds of particular reservations). The report should reference statutory authority or treaty article for each item.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mapping proceeds to statutes, acts, and treaties
rubrics_metrics.description: Entries reference statutes/acts/treaties (e.g., '12 Stat. 819, act March 3, 1869; Sees. 2 and 3, act of Feb. 21, 1863') and assign receipts to treaty fulfillment or statutory authority.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each receipt or appropriation related to land sales or royalties must be linked to the applicable treaty or statutory provision in the accounting description so legal authority for the receipt/disbursement is explicit.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conditional occupancy and settlement clauses
rubrics_metrics.description: set apart for the permanent use and occupancy of Chief Moses and his people, and such other friendly Indians as may elect to settle thereon with his consent and that of the Secretary of the Interior.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Orders can grant occupancy for a named group and allow other 'friendly' Indians to settle conditionally; such clauses require explicit consent conditions (consent of the named chief and the Secretary) establishing administrative controls over who may settle on the reserve addition.
